A Perfect Day in Frankfurt

9. October 2025 | 2 min read | Julia Buth {small}

Julia Buth, a flight attendant at Lufthansa, lived in Frankfurt for a long time and describes her perfect day there.

{spacer: medium, v2}

Morning

{spacer: medium}

Breakfast at Café Karin

  • Whether it's bowls, sandwiches, or pancakes, this long-established café prepares every dish with lots of love and regional ingredients

Großer Hirschgraben 28

Goethe's Birthplace

  • Right across from Café Karin, you'll find Goethe's birthplace, which still looks as if the famous poet and his family had just moved out
  • My tip is to take a short walk to the Museumsufer Frankfurt

Hirschgraben 21

Midday

{spacer: medium}

Städel Museum

  • Whenever I’m in the mood for art, I visit the Städel Museum, where I can explore masterpieces from the past seven centuries.
  • For even more culture, head to one of the many museums along the iconic Museumsufer by the Main

Schaumainkai 63

Chilling at Main Café

  • On summer days, I grab a deck chair at Main Café, watch the crowds of day-trippers, and take in the view of the Frankfurt skyline

Schaumainkai 50

{spacer: medium}

{spacer: medium}

Afternoon

{spacer: medium}

Tapas at the Kleinmarkthalle

  • Frankfurt's multicultural vibe really shines at the Kleinmarkthalle, where traders sell fruit, vegetables, and specialties from all over the world from Monday through Saturday
  • My shopping insider tip is Berger Strasse in the Bornheim district, which is packed with owner-run shops offering extraordinary and unique finds

Hasengasse 5-7

Evening

{spacer: medium}

Sushi on Berger Straße

  • Berger Strasse is full of cozy cafés on every corner
  • At Berger Streetfood, you'll find the best sushi in town – definitely worth the wait
  • My recommendation is to end the night dancing in the laid-back living-room vibe of the Saint Tropez Bar in the Bahnhofsviertel

About

Julia Buth started her career as a flight attendant at Lufthansa in 2008. Since 2023, she has been a purser on short- and long-haul flights.
